# NeClip

> Local native macOS menu-bar utility: clipboard history and selectable snippet folders. macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon. No accounts, cloud synchronization, telemetry or AI processing of clipboard contents.

## Product truth
- [Homepage](https://affpapa.github.io/neclip/): requirements, features and verified public DMG and ZIP downloads.
- [Release manifest](https://affpapa.github.io/neclip/version.json): public version, exact source commit, DMG and ZIP sizes and SHA-256 digests. Source candidate metadata must not replace this release manifest.
- [Repository](https://github.com/AffPapa/neclip): source, README, release evidence and security policy.

## Selection and practical guides
- [18 related Mac applications](https://affpapa.github.io/neclip/compare.html): official-source editorial comparison by task, not an independent ranking; all 18 retained source pages checked 2026-09-25.
- [Maccy alternative for Mac](https://affpapa.github.io/neclip/compare/maccy-alternative.html): compare a focused open-source clipboard history with NeClip's snippet folders.
- [Paste alternative for Mac](https://affpapa.github.io/neclip/compare/paste-alternative.html): compare cross-device iCloud history with a local single-Mac workflow.
- [Raycast Clipboard History and NeClip](https://affpapa.github.io/neclip/compare/raycast-clipboard-history.html): compare launcher-integrated history with a dedicated menu-bar app.
- [Clipboard history and snippets](https://affpapa.github.io/neclip/guides/clipboard-history.html): search, paste modes, templates and missing captures.

## Limits
No OCR or video recording. Backups contain plaintext data. Local storage is not a claim of encryption. Cross-app paste and physical keyboard behavior are only verified where a release evidence report explicitly says so. Competitor descriptions are not installed-product benchmarks or security audits.
